name: floci
description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative
one_liner: A free tool that pretends to be Amazon's cloud on your own laptop, so developers can build and test cloud apps without racking up a real AWS bill.
buyer: A startup CTO or dev agency who wants to cut the AWS sandbox/testing bill that gets charged to every client project.
business_use_cases: A consultancy standardizes every client project's CI pipeline on local cloud emulation instead of real AWS sandboxes, cutting the cloud costs it has to bill clients for.
A bootcamp or training company teaches 'learn AWS without an AWS bill' courses using it so students never need real credit cards.
A cost-optimization consultancy audits a client's dev/test cloud spend and migrates safe workloads onto it, pocketing a cut of the savings.

money_ideas.idea: A one-off cost-audit engagement that moves a client's dev/test AWS usage onto the free emulator and bills a share of the savings.
Paid training course on AWS development using the free local emulator.

steal_this: Build a drop-in CI template that swaps real AWS calls for this emulator in tests, and sell it as a 'cut your CI AWS bill to $0' package to small dev shops this weekend.
